scope: every activation ingress into generator fitting and the spectrum/invariant-subspace pipeline, both implementations

summary.note: Mean-centering appears ONLY inside the probe fitter (mu/sd standardization of features). Generator fits and the spectrum/invariant-subspace estimate consume raw activations. Therefore the item-3 recompute-without-centering applies only if the 8C run invoked spectrum_diagnostic(centered=True); checked against the run's driver when it lands.

findings.code: G = X.T @ X; lam_eff = lam * np.trace(G) / d + 1e-12; solve(G + lam_eff*I, X.T @ Y).T
findings.verdict: raw activations; no mean subtraction anywhere in fit_maps/ridge_fit

findings.code: H = system.states(eps, layer); hn = (H**2).sum(); defects use H directly

findings.verdict: probe features ARE standardized (mean-centered + scaled). This affects probe-based metrics only (C6, first_decodable_layer), NOT the generator fit and NOT the spectrum estimate

findings.code: _, S, Vt = np.linalg.svd(U, full_matrices=False)  # U = u_vectors, slot-conditional means, no grand-mean subtraction
findings.verdict: NOT centered: SVD taken on raw slot-mean vectors u_1..u_k. The invariant (all-ones) direction is retained in the span, which is what lets inv_dim separate permutation-rep (S-shared) from standard-rep (S-role)

findings.code: means = stack([rb[ans==j].mean(axis=0) ...]) — per-slot means of role blocks; the per-slot mean is a class-conditional mean, not a centering of activations
findings.verdict: class-conditional averaging only; no grand-mean removed

findings.code: DualRidge(X, Y, lam): XXt = X @ X.T on raw float64 casts of the cached fp16 activations; no mean subtraction
U = stack([X[lab==j].mean(0)]); if centered: U -= U.mean(0)
